name: What happens after a sewer camera inspection?

mainEntity.name: What happens after a sewer camera inspection?

acceptedAnswer.text: After the inspection, our technician will provide you with a detailed report of the findings, often including a video recording of the inside of your sewer line. They will explain any identified issues, their severity, and recommend appropriate solutions. This might involve repairs like hydro-jetting for blockages, spot repairs for minor damage, or complete pipe replacement for extensive problems. We'll discuss all options and help you make an informed decision about the next steps.
acceptedAnswer.description: You'll receive a detailed report and video of findings, with recommended solutions and an explanation of all your options.
